item.title: PHP Job Queues in 2026: Laravel Horizon vs Symfony Messenger vs Enqueue — Which One Should You Actually Use?
item.description: Your queue works fine until the day a job silently fails three thousand times in a row and nobody notices, because your only monitoring is a jobs table with a growing count. The three real options in the PHP ecosystem take fundamentally different positions: Laravel Horizon bets you already chose Redis and Laravel, Symfony Messenger bets you want a framework-agnostic message bus with pluggable transports, and Enqueue bets you want to talk to seven different brokers through one interface.
